name: project-progress
description: Project-local Markdown progress tracking for resumable, multi-step agent work. Bundles the project-progress skill, an MCP server for a cross-project index, and lifecycle hooks that inject resume context on session start and guard sensitive progress on commit.

interface.shortDescription: Resumable, project-local progress tracking for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Keep a per-project project-progress/ folder as the canonical resume source. The skill guides the agent to maintain it; the MCP server exposes a cross-project index; and lifecycle hooks inject the Resume Snapshot on session start, block committing progress files marked commit_progress:false or sensitivity:sensitive, and remind you to update progress when the working tree changed but Progress.md did not.
